candidate_policy: unchanged select_candidates: 3 recent then entity and TF-IDF, at most 8 earlier steps
field_policy: full fields for selected candidates and target decision/action; no target observation or final tests
reasoning_policy: DeepSeek official thinking.type=enabled, reasoning_effort=high; SSE reasoning stored separately
parse_policy: JSON or one fenced JSON object, then existing quote repair; no format-retry or reasoning salvage
failure_policy: one terminal result per target; missing edges on failed targets; retain validated edges and rule edges; all 102 ranked; report partial graphs and strict complete-graph sensitivity
pilot_policy: one longest-request target from median-length trajectory in each agent/model group, plus globally longest request; no gold-based selection
graph_quality_review: deterministic hash sample without gold: 24 accepted relations, 12 rejected relations, 12 unselected-or-no-edge candidate pairs; assistant review not independent human annotation
state_tracker: explicit_operations_v2; conservative invalidation on unsupported shell execution
